payload.name: Photo 200x230 Under 20KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 200 x 230 photo workflow for strict 20KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 200 x 230 photo under 20KB workflow for exam, profile, school, and application portals that require both exact pixels and a tiny file-size cap. It points to local resize and compression steps, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
